name: Bluetti AC70 power station, about 314 x 209 x 236 mm (APPROXIMATE)

electrical.note: Bluetti US store spec: solar input XT60, 12-58 V DC, 10 A max, 500 W; ships with an MC4-to-XT60 cable. Modelled as an MC4 + / - pair at the end of that cable. Strings in series and in parallel in the check line (series-aware).

mounts.note: origin = centre of the bottom face; stands on the ground beside the car

accepts.note: solar input + (XT60, via the MC4-to-XT60 cable), 12-58 V, 10 A max
solar input - (XT60, via the MC4-to-XT60 cable), 12-58 V, 10 A max

notes: Dimensions approximate (about 31.4 x 20.9 x 23.6 cm); the front faces +Z with a small screen, ports and the solar input on the left.
